title: 2026 UK ETS international-maritime proposal-status QA controls

sources.title: UK ETS scope expansion: emissions from international maritime voyages consultation
International maritime voyages consultation accessible webpage

facts.source_fact: The international maritime document is a consultation, not a final Authority Response.
The consultation was issued on 25 November 2025.
The Authority proposes international-maritime expansion from 2028.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat 2028 proposal as already commenced.

facts.source_fact: Domestic maritime UK ETS began separately from July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Separate current domestic scope from proposed international scope.

facts.source_fact: The consultation follows the delayed adoption of the IMO Net Zero Framework.
The consultation also follows the UK-EU agreement to work towards linking ETSs.
The consultation seeks views on scope, regulation, cap adjustment, future review and impacts.
Consultation proposals are broadly aligned with EU ETS emissions coverage.
Final policy decisions require an Authority Response and should not be inferred from consultation text.
